note: Issue #45's test planet: an asteroid station a short hop from the port, with a size-1 town (a cantina with a stage, a guard at its door, a merchant in front, locals in the street) in metal (issue #75). Issue #99: a real ball (the asteroid type), the station sealed under a dome with a hallway to the port's landing pit, and flown to with no fade: 'at' is the centre of its ball in metres from the port, and its own port is on top of it. Its cantina owner is a new Oda, generated for this planet (no card: see src/systems/planets/planet_owner.gd). Everything else comes from the planet generator. See docs/planets/PLANETS.md.

landmarks.note: A space station holding over the moon's far side from the home planet (out of sight of the port), 1400 m up: inside the moon's own scene (its handoff reaches 2600 m), so you fly to the moon, round it, and Z takes you into the bay. Its bay's mouth turns toward the moon's port; yaw_deg turns it about its up. The station is its own component (content/core/stations/orbital_station.json, src/systems/world/station_hull.gd): to take it to another planet, move this block into that planet's landmarks ('side': 'far' needs a planet with a 'near' parent; otherwise give 'at' and 'altitude' like the cruiser's).
